answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 8042 Country: United States of America Title: If someone in very great and desperate need of money leaves a country while taking loan from that country (bank loan, no interest) and moves to another country with the intention of repaying one day when he is capable of repaying it or with the intention of giving it in charity, is this permissible? Question: If someone in very great and desperate need of money leaves a country while taking loan from that country (bank loan, no interest) and moves to another country with the intention of repaying one day when he is capable of repaying it or with the intention of giving it in charity, is this permissible? Answer ID: 8042 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1032/1032=M/1429) It is allowed. But it is not allowed to give it in charity until he is able to pay to the original owner or bank (who credited). It is necessary to pay to one who gave you the loan. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
